description: Searches Newcollab's directory of vetted UGC (user-generated content) creators by niche, with optional platform and country filters. Returns up to 8 creators with platform, niches, follower band, engagement and gifting preference, a handle and profile link for creators with a public profile, and a link to start a gifted creator roster on Newcollab. Use when the user wants to find UGC creators or micro-influencers for product seeding, PR packages, or TikTok or Instagram ads.

limit.description: Number of preview creators to return.

niche.description: Primary vertical or category, e.g. 'skincare', 'fitness', 'supplements', 'pet products'.

name: search_ugc_creators
title: Search vetted UGC creators
